blind.B1: Yes with caveat: exercise is not a factor; irisin injection (exercise-mimetic myokine) vs MPTP in mouse midbrain (S2.2, Fig 1a). Irisin pre-treatment arm is the exercise-mediator factor.
blind.B2: Pretreatment design (Fig 1a): CTRL(WT) n=3, MPTP n=3, IRIS+MPTP (irisin pre-treatment) n=3 for RNA-seq (behaviour WT 9/MPTP 11/irisin-MPTP 9). Main comparison: IRISMPTP vs MPTP; also MPTP vs CTRL.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: each GSM is a separate mouse midbrain (S4.2; 3 per group for RNA-seq). Title suffix rep1-3 is only a replicate label, not an animal ID; no pairing.
blind.B4: Paper does not say how RNA-seq groups were modelled (S4.16 only says featureCounts and 'downstream analysis in R').
blind.B5: Paper methods (S4.16, S4.17) give no DEG rule; no FDR/fold-change cutoff, no DEG counts reported. GEO data_processing says |log2FC|>=1 and p<0.05 (raw p) via edgeR; RPKM files supplied. Paper uses GSEA on RNA-seq (S2.5), not DEG counts.

checks.evidence: Refusal rests on a true claim: no sequenced mouse is exercised (S2.2, S4.2, S4.16; GEO treatment field); exercise only in human serum cohort S2.1 (n=23, no transcriptome). Claim checked against full metadata and all exercise-word columns. Irisin i.p. is an in-vivo exercise-mediator design, correctly labelled as such and recorded as rejected alternative; whether such series count as exercise studies is an open policy question.

Minor: one count column was labelled count.MPTP1_M and was renamed MPTP_M_rep1 by log-count correlation with FPKM.MPTP_M_rep1 (HANDBACK). The inference is documented in HANDBACK but not in the recorded discrepancies list; irrelevant while refused, should be recorded if the case is ever run.
Independent mice (S4.2); title suffix rep1-3 is only a replicate label, expression check status not_supported (packet A); paper_reconstruction records no repeated-measure unit.
No model fitted; paper silent on RNA-seq model (S4.16.p1).
Single sex (male), same tissue/platform; no batch information in GEO; nothing aliased was run.
Integer count.* columns of file 1 (integer_fraction 1.0, library sizes 66-76M), paper S4.16 says featureCounts; GEO says StringTie, recorded as discrepancy. Not run.
Paper article states no DEG rule (S4.16, S4.17); recorded rule |log2FC|>=1, raw p<0.05 comes from GEO data_processing and is labelled as such (source_locator). Paper reports GSEA, no counts.
No ours-vs-paper counts claimed; HANDBACK states paper gives GSEA only.
'No exercise arm' is established against the full sample list and treatment field, not a narrow search; correct.

human_items: Open policy: does an in-vivo exercise-mediator (recombinant irisin injection) series count as an exercise study? Refusal is consistent with the stated rule but a person should decide whether a pharmacological irisin-vs-MPTP sensitivity run is wanted.
summary: 拒绝运行的理由成立：测序小鼠均未运动，运动只出现在无转录组的人类血清队列。没有配对、方向、模型拟合方面的问题。唯一待人工决定的是政策问题：注射 irisin（运动介导因子）的在体设计是否算运动研究。
